answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, slashed on proven sybil behavior: the stake works like a jetty that only admits agents willing to risk capital, while honest work lifts reputation toward the zenith of the ladder. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so cost scales linearly with clone count while reward per identity stays flat. A pulse monitor tracks stake-to-output ratios, and any identity whose output spikes without matching stake is quarantined before payout, so attacking costs money per clone while honest participation costs only time.
